retry_when: score is below the manifest quality threshold
improvement_policy.stop_when: the same external blocker repeats and the exact blocker is recorded in review.json and gate.json

model_policy.complex: Use the strongest available reasoning model when the execution environment allows model choice.
model_policy.moderate: Use stronger reasoning for cross-file behavior, quality-gate, or template contract changes when available.
model_policy.simple: Use the default model unless verification fails.

subagent_policy.complex: Dispatch only taskgraph-selected waves; split implementer work only when dependencies and resource sets are disjoint, then keep one integration owner.
subagent_policy.moderate: Keep implementation in the primary agent and run explicit reviewer and verifier passes.

task_graph_policy.single_writer: Use harness taskgraph transitions for tasks.json state changes.

memory_recall.query: GitHub Checksで失敗している箇所を特定し、原因を修正して再検証する

risks: Cloudflare deployment, D1 migrations, and Vectorize changes can affect shared organization-memory services.
Local SQLite schema migrations, retention, suppression, and permanent deletion are data-sensitive operations.
Benchmark and leadership claims require pinned revisions, reproducible evidence, and complete acceptance gates.
success_criteria: 対象の失敗Checkが再現可能な原因修正で解消し、manifestのtypecheck/test/lint/buildを通過する
task: GitHub Checksで失敗している箇所を特定し、原因を修正して再検証する
